thread:
eva: Quick sync — planning private offers for the new Appliance X with HW partner and SIs. Need a simple, enforceable pricing shape before customer pilots. High level asks: tiered commit with 3x ramp, SI enablement credit line, a renewal conversion target, and cap on stacked discounts. Thoughts?
raj: Love the structure. Can we make the ramp explicit? e.g., commit milestone at month 1/3/6 with % of annual commit unlocked for discount tiers. Keeps partners honest.
maria: Agree on milestones. Also add a short clause for early usage spike protection (burst buffer) — customers often overshoot in first 30 days. No one wants surprise overages.
alex: +1 on burst buffer. For SIs, suggest a separate attach credit (one-time) tied to customer go-live rather than % off list. Easier to audit.
jorge: We should avoid stacking the SI credit with channel rebate and early-adopter discount. Propose a hard discount stack cap at 25% total, and an exception process for strategic deals.
eva: typo: 'eva' — re: exceptions, ok but need guardrails: legal approval + revenue ops signoff for any override.
maria: For renewal mechanics: propose a conversion MIR (minimum incremental renewal) target of 70% consumption of committed units by renewal window. If below, partner must provide remediation plan and customer incentive.
raj: Metrics we can feasibly report from marketplace: consumed units, customer active seats, last 90d consumption. We'll need marketplace SKU mapping so RBPs match metered usage.
marketplace-bot: Reminder: private offers on AWS/GCP need a SKU mapping doc and a 48h lead time for account-level entitlements. See https://marketplace.internal/sku-mapping
alex: On announcement cadence — avoid joint press until one customer > $X ARR converts. Otherwise keep joint blog post to 'partner enablement' language.
jorge: Contract language: must include a clause that reserved commit is non-refundable but transferable across the customer's org (to avoid churn blockers).
eva: Good. On discount tiers: Tier A (>=$250k/yr) = 18% off list, Tier B (>=$500k/yr) = 22%, Tier C (>=$1M/yr) = 28% but capped at 25 when combining SI credits. Also offer a 6-month price protection at renewal for Tier B/C.
maria: Suggest a SKU-level surcharge for on-prem support (flat $X/mo) so we don't erode unit economics on air-gapped installs.
raj: Ops ask: we need sample PO templates and marketplace private-offer payload examples. I'll draft a spreadsheet mapping SKUs -> entitlements.
eva: Action items: 1) Raj to draft SKUs + metrics mapping (due EOD Wed). 2) Alex to draft joint-announce gating (due Fri). 3) Maria to write renewal conversion clause & remediation playbook (due next Tue). 4) Jorge to draft discount stacking policy & exception flow (due next Tue). 5) Legal to prepare private-offer T&Cs (I'll ping).
marketplace-bot: Note: created ticket PM-6421 for SKU mapping. Link: https://tracker.internal/PM-6421
alex: One more thing — SI enablement credits should be redeemable within 9 months, else expire. Keeps momentum.
jorge: +1 on expiry. Also require SI to submit a one-pager proof-of-work to claim credit.
eva: ok, locking this shape unless anyone raises a hard objection by EOD tomorrow. Thanks all :thumbsup:
